faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick and instant answers
faq.q1: How do I earn coins teaching my native language?
faq.a1: Enable 'Teaching Mode' in your profile and stay available. When a student calls you, you automatically earn coins for each minute of conversation completed.
faq.q2: Why are calls charged per minute?
faq.a2: SayNative operates with a closed community economy. The per-minute fee rewards the time and commitment of native speakers, ensuring high quality and instant availability.
faq.q3: Can I cash out my coins for real money?
faq.a3: Currently, coins are exclusively for use within SayNative to learn and practice with tutors. A verified creator payout program will be launched soon.
faq.q4: What happens if a call drops in the first few seconds?
faq.a4: If a call ends within the first 15 seconds due to technical glitches or unexpected disconnection, no coins are deducted from your balance.
